biggest_catch: You bid against other operators for every Op — a thin profile loses bids, and you only get paid if a business accepts your bid.
catches: You must win bids to work; businesses choose from Operator Profiles, so incomplete profiles get passed over.
Onboarding requires a background check, the Vault payment application, and tax forms before you can bid.
Ops are concentrated in manufacturing, distribution, and warehousing in ~25 listed metro areas — availability is metro-dependent.
Payment goes to the in-app Vault account (virtual card auto-issued; physical card optional), not your existing bank.

c1.evidence: Official Veryable app listing (published by Veryable, Inc.): operators bid on flexible Ops in manufacturing, distribution, and warehousing.

c2.evidence: Official listing: 'you will receive your payment 24 hours after working the Op through our in-app payment solution Vault.' Per-Op bid amount is the agreed pay.

c3.evidence: No fee to join; background check, Vault application, and tax forms are onboarding steps, not fees.

c4.evidence: Official listing: 'Complete the work assignment (Op) and get paid the next day!' and 'Get paid daily, even on holidays and weekends!' Bounded next-day timing confirmed.

eligibility: Background check; Vault payment application; tax forms; available in listed metro areas.
maximize: Load your Operator Profile with every real skill and certification you have — businesses pick winning bids off that profile, so a complete profile is the whole game. Bid on Ops near you every day; payment lands in your Vault about 24 hours after each Op, weekends and holidays included, so stack Ops back-to-back to keep daily pay flowing.

steps: Download the Veryable app and complete onboarding: background check, Vault payment application, tax forms.
Build your Operator Profile with accurate skills and certifications.
Bid on Ops in your area; businesses accept bids based on your profile.
Get paid 24 hours later into your Vault account (virtual card auto-issued; physical card optional).
timing: Payment 24 hours after working the Op via the in-app Vault payment solution — next-day pay, including weekends and holidays. Virtual card issued automatically; physical card can be ordered.
payout_value_note: variable per-task pay shown in-app before accepting; no fixed amount in official terms

who_qualifies: A background check, the Vault payment application, and tax forms before you can bid; in Veryable's roughly 25 listed metro areas; Ops are concentrated in manufacturing, distribution, and warehousing.

what_gets_accepted: Win the bid and complete the Op as assigned. Payment comes 24 hours after working the Op.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: onboarding (background check, Vault application, tax forms) before you can bid, time spent bidding on Ops you don't win, and building up your profile.
